purpose: Research-only follow-up to canonical Monster v1. Test whether the weak+early candidate-family edge survives when the failed volr20 Top-N selection layer is removed.

parent_evidence.decision_context: The v1 candidate pool passed its 2023 family gate, but every registered Top1/Top2/Top3/Top5 policy failed and chosen_top_n remained null.

fixed_candidate_family.market_gate: previous official XTKS session cross-sectional median ret5 <= 0
fixed_candidate_family.ret10_threshold_provenance: 2023 V18 consensus median ret10, as already frozen in canonical v1
fixed_candidate_family.note: No 2026 outcome may be used to alter these gates.

v2_selection_policy.name: ALL_WEAK_EARLY
v2_selection_policy.tie_break: symbol ascending for deterministic output only; not a selection criterion
v2_selection_policy.same_symbol_cooldown: one immediately preceding official XTKS session; apply after family eligibility, independently of return labels
v2_selection_policy.rationale: Canonical v1 showed lower performance after Top-N ranking than in the full qualifying pool. V2 tests whether the selection layer, rather than the family gate, was destroying useful right-tail breadth.

evaluation.target: next official XTKS session open to close of the fifth official XTKS session including entry
evaluation.development_warning: Both years have already been inspected. They are mechanism-development evidence, not OOS validation.
evaluation.locked_replay_warning: 2025 outcomes have prior family-level exposure in older V12-V15 research, so this is a locked retrospective replay, not pristine OOS.
evaluation.reporting_only: 2026 historical outcomes remain reporting-only and must not be used to tune the policy.
evaluation.prospective_shadow: After this freeze, future sessions may be logged without rule changes; 5-session outcomes may be evaluated only after they mature.

predeclared_locked_replay_gates_at_cost_.rule: Do not relax these gates after opening the 2025 locked replay.

reference_only_not_v2_results.warning: These are parent-pool diagnostics before the v2 cooldown replay. They motivate the hypothesis but are not v2 backtest results.

production_boundary: Never merge to main, alter production Stable/Sniper/Mega, TradingView, Discord, Sheets, watchlist-builder/updater, or production workflows without explicit user Go.
next_execution: Replay ALL_WEAK_EARLY with the frozen one-session same-symbol cooldown on 2023-2024 and record exact metrics.
Without changing rules, execute the locked 2025 replay and evaluate the predeclared gates.
Prepare an ordinary-runtime prospective shadow scorer so post-freeze signals can accumulate genuinely forward evidence.
